title: Waiting, Spiritism, and the Judgment of Darkness
description: The prophet seals the testimony among the disciples and places his hope in the Lord who hides His face from the house of Jacob. He warns against seeking counsel from spiritists and mediums instead of God, and urges the people back to the law and the testimony. He describes a future of hunger, distress, and thick darkness for those who curse their king and their God, but concludes with the promise that the darkness will not last forever: in the land of Zebulun and Naphtali, Galilee of the Gentiles, glory shall come instead of shame [ref:Jes 8:16-23|Isaiah 8:16-23].
